agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ was synthesizing new _TokenType instances for dunder attribute lookups (e.g. __deepcopy__), causing callers like copy.deepcopy() to receive a non-callable _TokenType and then raise TypeError: '_TokenType' object is not callable. Added a guard so dunder-style names raise AttributeError instead, restoring correct deepcopy/copy/pickle behavior for token types and parsed statements, while normal dynamic token attribute creation (e.g. Token.Keyword.Foo) continues to work unchanged.
